I was driving home on a two-lane road in Baytown, Texas, when the car in front of me stopped short and I could not
avoid it. We collided head-on at low speed, though the impact was enough to throw me forward against the wheel and
then back into my seat. My head struck the side window, and for several minutes afterward I felt dizzy, confused, and
nauseous. A paramedic on scene and later the doctor I saw both diagnosed a concussion. I have given this same

add or change. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this claim so my medical bills and lost work
